company.name: Rapyd
company.shortDescription: Rapyd is a financial technology company that provides payment processing and fintech infrastructure for businesses.
company.description: Rapyd is a financial technology company that provides infrastructure for global payments and embedded financial services through APIs. It enables businesses to accept payments, send payouts, and manage money movement using a single platform that connects multiple local and international payment methods. The company supports services such as card issuing, digital wallets, foreign exchange, and multi-currency accounts to help businesses operate across different markets. Its platform is used by companies in areas like e-commerce, marketplaces, online gaming, and digital services to simplify cross-border transactions and financial operations. Rapyd also integrates compliance, licensing, and payment processing capabilities so businesses can operate without building their own financial infrastructure.
